audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Ziggs Level 1 and Level 6 and gave Quinn First item and 2+ items. That contradicts the already-audited mirror (quinn__ziggs) and contradicts the kits: Blinding Assault has 1025 range against Ziggs' 850-range Q, so Quinn owns the early levels, while Ziggs owns the two-item stage on waveclear and R siege.
audit.why: Mirror findings state: Quinn rows 0-2, Skill rows 3-5, Ziggs row 6, both layers. Range numbers come straight from the kits (Quinn Q 1025 / E 675; Ziggs Q 850 / E 900 / W 1000).
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 Quinn (3/10, 3/10, 4/10), rows 3-5 Skill (5/10), row 6 Ziggs (7/10) — proposed as one atomic group across phases[N].side and win[N].

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a pure Ziggs spike; Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines spikes at the same level and the page treated first item as a Quinn stage and two items as a Quinn stage, which is backwards.
audit.why: Both champions spike at 6 (Mega Inferno Bomb, 5000 range, 120/95/70s vs Behind Enemy Lines). Ziggs' scaling stage is the two-item mark, where waveclear and R siege beat single-target burst.
audit.corrected: Level 6 becomes Skill with both ults named; the two-item row becomes Ziggs; first item stays even.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated. The page repeatedly claimed 'your Q out-ranges' — false. It also never said what Vault actually does on arrival, what Quinn's blind does and does not stop, or that Satchel answers her ult.
audit.why: Kit text: Vault (E, 675 range, 12/11/10/9/8s) dashes to a target, damages, slows and 'briefly interrupts' it, then leaps off to max attack range — so it is engage and disengage in one and it interrupts a cast. Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) hinders vision: it takes your Short Fuse (P) empowered auto, not your Q/W/E, which are not basic attacks. Satchel Charge (W, 20/18/16/14/12s, 1000 range) knocks enemies away and is flagged percentHealth, and Behind Enemy Lines (R) is flagged channel/interruptible, so the Satchel knockback ends it.
audit.corrected: Stated in report[5].t and breakdown.early: her Q out-ranges yours by 175 units, Vault interrupts your cast, her blind only removes your Short Fuse auto, and W Satchel both knocks her out of Vault range and cancels Behind Enemy Lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing cues; nothing gave a number.
audit.why: Vault is 12s at rank 1 down to 8s maxed; W Satchel is 20s at rank 1 down to 12s. The step-up window is the gap between them.
audit.corrected: Concrete numbers written into phases[1].why, phases[3].why and breakdown.early.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged wants.foe[0] 'Land Blinding Assault (Q)' as a probable wrong name. It is the real Riot name for Quinn's Q — a false positive. Left untouched.

edits.after: Blinding Assault reaches 1025 to your Q's 850 — she pokes your last-hits from outside your range and strolls off.

edits.after: Stack Manaflow and chip her below 60% — that is the R plus jungle execute window. Count her Vault, 9s by rank 4, before every step forward.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Mega Inferno Bomb online, and so is Behind Enemy Lines — hold R for the sub-60% window and ping her the moment she leaves.

edits.before: Your Q and E out-range Quinn's auto-and-Vault poke, letting you win the level-1 farm trade.
edits.after: Blinding Assault reaches 1025 to your Q's 850, so she pokes your level-1 farm for free.

edits.before: At level 2 your Q bounce still zones her off the wave before her kit comes online.
edits.after: Vault arrives at 2 on a 12s cooldown — she dashes in, blinds, and leaves before W is back.

edits.before: Level 3 you have E minefield to punish any Vault engage, keeping the lane in your favour.
edits.after: E minefield slows her Vault exit, but her 1025 Q still out-ranges every bomb you own.

edits.before: Through 4-5 your superior range and waveclear keep her pinned and poked.
edits.after: Through 4-5 it evens out: your waveclear against her dash-blind-step-out loop.

edits.before: At level 6 you shove her under tower and deny the roam window her R wants.
edits.after: Both spike at 6: your R punishes her roam, her R dives you from odd angles.

edits.before: Quinn spikes at 6: Behind Enemy Lines plus Vault reset lets her dive or roam and flip the lead.
edits.after: First item stays level: Blackfire Torch burn chip against her lethality burst and dive threat.

edits.before: A real poke war — your Q out-ranges, his Vault (Dash/Blind) punishes. Trade bombs and dodge the answer.
edits.after: A poke war you lose on range — her Q reaches 1025 to your 850. Farm safe, punish Vault, hold the Satchel.

edits.before: A real poke war — your Q out-ranges, his Vault (Dash/Blind) punishes. Trade bombs and dodge the answer.

edits.after: You do not win the first levels on range — Blinding Assault reaches 1025 to your Q's 850. Farm safe, E her landing spot, hold W for her Vault.

edits.before: Track Quinn’s Vault (Dash/Blind): Blind + disengage in one button — fight while it is down. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Vault interrupts your cast, and her blind only takes your Short Fuse auto, never your bombs. Satchel knocks her out of Vault range and ends her R.

edits.before: You dominate levels 1-2: your Q out-ranges her autos and Blinding Assault, so poke her every time she steps to farm and don't let her free-trade.
edits.after: You do not dominate 1-2: Blinding Assault reaches 1025 to your Q's 850, so farm at range, dodge her step-ins, and wait on W Satchel at level 2.
